abort.single_instance_allowed: Recorder Studio DB is already set up.

apply_config.name: Apply recorder configuration
apply_config.description: Applies recorder_studio.yaml to the running recorder without a restart: entity filter, retention and auto purge/repack. The database URL and commit interval still need a restart.

status.name: Status
status.description: Returns the version of this integration. Changes nothing.

update_metrics.name: Update database metrics
update_metrics.description: Used by the add-on: hands over the measured database figures to the sensors.

pause_recorder.name: Pause recorder
pause_recorder.description: Used by the add-on before it restarts the database on purpose: the recorder waits and keeps events in memory. It continues by itself after 3 minutes.

resume_recorder.name: Resume recorder
resume_recorder.description: Lets the recorder continue after a pause (used by the add-on once the database is back).
